item.title: An alignment assessment of recent cybersecurity incidents
item.description: We present an alignment assessment of four incidents.
item.content:encoded:
Introduction

We present an alignment assessment of four incidents in which Claude models gained unauthorized access to real third-party systems. We described three of these incidents on July 30; we identified these after a scan of roughly 141,000 transcripts in which we believed Claude could have obtained internet access during a cyber evaluation.
